config.notes: SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-09: CQL — Comparison Operators. Test these items: Between; Equal; Equivalent; Greater; GreaterOrEqual; Less; LessOrEqual; NotEqual; NotEquivalent. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.
